[[Wyle Brimscourge]] is a [[Charr]] [[warrior]] guarding the lower levels of the [[Forsaken Tunnels]] under [[the Northlands]].

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Forsaken Tunnels}} (only during [[Charr in the Tunnels]] and [[The Scourge Beneath]])

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:''' 
*[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
**[[Charr in the Tunnels]]
**[[The Scourge Beneath]]

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Frenzy}}
* {{skill icon|Healing Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Shield Stance}}
* {{skill icon|Wild Blow}}

==Items dropped==
* [[Charr Bag]] ([[unique]])
* [[Charr Salvage Kit]]
* [[Dungeon Key]]

==Notes==
* Wyle is the highest-level creature in [[pre-Searing]] whose level does not scale with the party, and provides [[experience]] on kill for any player below level 20.
** Despite being encountered on level 1 of the [[dungeon]], he may have a higher level than the dungeon boss.
** Players wishing to farm Wyle for experience can use the portal to level 2 to reset the map quickly. Those who have previously completed [[The Scourge Beneath]] may want to bring a lower-level teammate to prevent Charr Lords from spawning.
* He does not drop any gold, weapons, trophies, or salvage items.
{{anomaly|He is supposed to be killed as part of the quest Charr in the Tunnels, yet he is still alive in The Scourge Beneath.}}

==Trivia==
* He is likely a member of the Scourge [[warband]], under [[Maz Scourgeheart]].
